name: anim_hira_riseA
subject: a very tall, extremely muscular horse man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream swirls
desc: The flat brown paint puddle heaves and squelches up into a thick shapeless mound: thick paint swells and wells up, bubbles bulge and pop, sticky strands stretch and sag, heavy drips run down. Only goo, no body parts. Slow, heavy, sticky, viscous, gooey.
